messages.author: Lena
messages.text: We need to decide on infrastructure. ECS or Kubernetes?

messages.author: Ravi
messages.text: ECS is fine until we scale. I'd say move when we hit 40 services.

messages.author: Lena
messages.text: OK let's stay on ECS until 40 services, then revisit.

entry.title: Stay on ECS until we hit 40 services — revisit Kubernetes migration then
entry.author: Lena V.

messages.author: Joel
messages.text: Found the bug — billing cron was set to UTC. Running at midnight UTC = 5pm Pacific, overlapping with evening jobs.

messages.author: Joel
messages.text: Moved it to 02:00 Pacific. Duplicate invoices should stop.

entry.title: Billing cron was running in UTC, causing duplicate invoices — moved to 02:00 Pacific
entry.author: Joel R.

messages.author: Ravi
messages.text: How do I get access to the staging database? I can't find it anywhere.

messages.author: Megan
messages.text: Request the Okta role 'eng-staging-db'. It's in #it-access. Takes about 10 min.

entry.title: Staging DB access is granted via the Okta role 'eng-staging-db' — request in #it-access
entry.author: Megan C.

messages.author: Priya
messages.text: Who's the final call on large refunds? We have a $800 request and no one's sure.

messages.author: Daniel
messages.text: That's me. I own all refund decisions over $500. Ping me directly.

entry.title: Daniel owns all refund decisions over $500 and is the final approver
entry.author: Daniel F.

messages.author: Hannah
messages.text: Actually, ignore the earlier decision on webhooks.

messages.author: Hannah
messages.text: OK, let's go with 3 retries with backoff, then send to manual review. That replaces the old policy.
